notes: Native Android app (Kotlin + Compose + Firebase). No web frontend exists: the 'web-preview' service (nginx) serves an info page + the compiled debug APK on port 3000 so the Base44 preview loads and the APK can be installed on a phone. Build the APK with: docker compose -f docker-compose.base44.yml run --rm apk-builder. Output: TaxiDrive_v2_beta/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk (download at /apk/app-debug.apk).
